# @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.8.1-rc.1

Release candidate for DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` through `0.2.1-rc.4`.

## Compatibility

- Declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh >=0.2.1-rc.2 <=0.2.1-rc.4`.
- Install and Web boot smoke tests pass on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, and `0.2.1-rc.4`.
- Keeps the published 0.8 attention behavior, native TaskManager shadow, Queue/Delete quick actions, notification preferences, and linked-Session navigation.

## DSH 0.2.1 build migration

- Updates the native Schedule snapshot build to the DSH 0.2.1 `clientBundle(packageDir, ...)` contract.
- Builds only the browser Client artifact for the synthetic native helper instead of inventing a Node-half entry.
- Rebuilds the generated native TaskManager client and verifies that only platform externals remain.
- DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` does not expose an npm `gitHead` and has no matching public source tag. The build therefore compares the published `ui-schedule` and `ui-primitives` rc.3/rc.4 `lib` trees and uses the official `dsh-v0.2.1-rc.3` source only when those published artifacts are byte-for-byte equivalent.

## Plugin artwork

- Exports the official display resource as `"./icon": "./icon.svg"` while retaining the existing top-level `icon` field.

## Validation

- `npm run check`: pass.
- `npm pack --dry-run`: pass.
- Native Schedule snapshot build: pass.
- DSH install + Web boot: pass on rc.2, rc.3, rc.4.

This remains an RC until the final browser UI is verified in a real DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` profile.
